kicker: RSI-top, read against its own data

scenes.headline: How a stalled research agent finds a new valley
scenes.sub: RSI-top: a dashboard and a diverse cohort
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Doily! Long agent research runs stop improving while they stay busy. This harness notices, and sends agents somewhere new.

scenes.text: Keep a compact dashboard of every experiment, and when progress stalls, push a cohort of agents to disagree on purpose.
scenes.say: Keep a compact dashboard of every experiment. When progress stalls, push a group of agents to disagree on purpose.

scenes.title: The loop, and the way out

steps.say: An evolution loop changes a parent and scores the child. Every attempt lands in an archive.
Scripts written before the run turn each attempt into one row of twenty five numbers.
A monitor watches the best score. Flat for twenty minutes, and the search pauses.
A cohort of agents scans the rows, opens a few full attempts, and runs its proposals in parallel. Then the search resumes.

scenes.title: Three ways to make agents disagree
scenes.say: One shared dashboard gives everyone the same idea. So the agents are pushed apart.

items.say: Each agent sees a different random subset of the metrics.
Each proposes eight directions at once, so the unusual ones survive.
Each builds on a different branch of the history, not the current best.

left.title: Reset the context
left.say: Other fixes reset the agent and keep only the files. That loses the map.

right.title: Index the history
right.say: This one keeps a row per experiment, and opens the full record only when it matters.

scenes.title: Kernel task, final cycles, lower is better
scenes.note: one run each, no repeat seeds
scenes.say: On the kernel task, the best case goes from twelve seventy five cycles to eleven oh nine. One run each.

scenes.label: Lite competitions medalled, in each of 3 seeds
scenes.note: no same-harness baseline without the cohort
scenes.say: On a machine learning benchmark, it medals in seventeen of twenty two competitions, every seed. How much is the cohort is not shown.

scenes.text: Don't throw the history away. Index it, and make the agents disagree when the search stalls.
scenes.say: Don't throw the history away. Index it, and make the agents disagree when the search stalls.

recap: Score every attempt into a dashboard
Pause when the best score goes flat
Send a cohort out three different ways
scenes.say: Score every attempt. Pause when progress goes flat. Send the agents out different ways.
